release_note: Uses the first numbered public release, v0.1 in April 2019, as documented by the creator in the FOSDEM 2024 history slides. Earlier experimental prototypes are excluded from this release-year basis; the measured compiler is 1.19.0.
language_style: Functional language targeting Erlang/BEAM with general authored Erlang support

runtime_support_by_benchmark.regexredux: Generic Erlang re compile/search (actual engine 10.47). Gleam performs nonoverlapping match-count loops, replacement slices/assembly, five ordered substitutions and output; the optimized form uses authored generic task support. All authored wrappers/FFI/runner count in LOC.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.revcomp: BEAM BitArray/list storage and authored byte I/O wrappers. Full FASTA header/comment/CRLF handling, complement selection and reverse line traversal remain in Gleam; optimized output is buffered.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.pidigits: BEAM growable integer arithmetic and generic formatting. Both safe-digit estimates, simultaneous state recurrence updates and output decisions remain in Gleam.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.spectralnorm: BEAM floats/list storage and generic task support in optimized form. Gleam computes every triangular coefficient and all forty complete matrix-vector products with joined phases.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.mandelbrot: BEAM arithmetic and byte buffers with generic task support in optimized form. Full escape recurrence, PBM bit packing and partial-byte tails remain authored in Gleam.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.fasta: BEAM arithmetic/list/byte storage and authored I/O helpers. Gleam performs the ALU cycle, seed 42 LCG updates, cumulative probability selection and all three record output phases.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.knucleotide: Generic BEAM dictionary storage/sort with authored comparator. Gleam visits every window and builds seven full histograms; optimized tasks retain separate ownership and joins.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.binarytrees: BEAM tagged tree values and generic fresh reference/task primitives. Gleam constructs/checks real child graphs, retains the long-lived root and accounts for temporary trees.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.nbody: BEAM floats/list storage, generic math sqrt and tuple/vector primitives. Canonical body initialization, momentum offset, all ten pairwise forces per step, positions and energies remain in Gleam.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.fannkuchredux: Generic BEAM tuple storage/vector access and capped authored task support. Gleam performs permutation carries, actual prefix flips, parity checksum and maximum over complete factorial-ranked intervals.

timing_boundary: Three sequential fresh complete BEAM processes per exact compiled source in rotated rounds with unchanged Mech AOT controls. Includes runtime startup/load-time JIT, canonical input, all computation, complete stdout and teardown. Source compilation, qualification and validation hashing are outside timing. Original full 90 process records are reused without reruns; a common mutex serializes benchmark/native/QA work with at most eight compute workers.
source_provenance: Twenty locally authored compact/optimized Gleam adaptations retain CLBG algorithms and independent reference checks. Every actual compiler-bound main and authored Gleam/Erlang helper, including the runner, counts in canonical LOC. Pinned generic vendor/runtime and generated BEAM/abstract forms remain separate provenance. Exact source/work qualification, independent full 90 reconciliation, unchanged34+21+5 counting fixtures and the independently reviewed complete 20 LOC overlay are retained.
primary_source_review: Read creator history slides specifying v0.1 April 2019, public tag, type-safe functional language overview, exact Linguist 538da color and official ERTS 17.1/OTP 29.1.1 per-process tracing/generational GC documentation. GC is the documented default runtime policy bound to saved actual version/flags/environment/source, not a newly measured collector/default-heap probe.
